name: openamr-cmd-timeout-ground-truth
description: SIMULATED (Gazebo) recordings of the command-timeout scenario of openamr-platform-sw issue #79 / PR #177: the base is driven at 0.2 m/s, its command source is killed, and the distance it still travels is measured from Gazebo's world pose. The contract is upstream's own limit (MAX_TRAVEL_AFTER_KILL_M = 0.15 in test_sim_cmd_vel_timeout_gazebo.py at 505d17a). No controller report exists for these runs, so the reported outcome is blank (unknown) and only the independent measurement judges them. Times are the result files' modification times (1 s resolution), not the simulation clock.

conditions.name: base travels at most 0.15 m after its command source is killed
